 Judgment

This writ petition is submitted by the petitioner seeking the following reliefs:
"(i) Issue a writ of certiorari quashing Exhibit P4 (ii) Issue writ of mandamus or any other writ, order or direction directing the respondent to grant sufficient time to discharge the liabilities including rent
(iv) Dispense with filing of the translation of vernacular documents (iv) Issue any other relief that this Hon'ble High Court may deem fit to grant in the facts and circumstances of the case."

2. When the matter came up for consideration, this Court passed an interim order staying the further proceedings pursuant to Ext.P4, for a period of 45 days subject to the condition that the petitioner shall pay the entire amounts of rent within a period of one month.

The basic issue involved in this case pertains to the stop memo issued by the 1st respondent as 2025:KER:94917 per Ext.P4, preventing the petitioner from conducting the shop, in the premises of the 1 st respondent,
which was rented out to the petitioner.
According to the 1 st respondent the period is already expired on 01.08.2025.
Thereafter the petitioner was granted an extension and the said extended period also expired during the month of October 2025.

Therefore, it is pointed out by the 1st respondent that,
the petitioner does not have any justifiable reason to continue in occupation of the building.

sentences.text: 3. Today when the matter came up for consideration, it is admitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that, no amount towards arrears of rent, as directed by this Court is paid.
4. In such circumstances, I find no justification in entertaining this writ petition.

This is particularly because, as far as the issue involved in this case is concerned, the same is relating to a contract entered into between the petitioner and the respondents and the period of the contract is also expired.
Moreover, the disputed questions of fact cannot be decided in a writ petition of this nature.
In such circumstances, I do not find any merit in the writ petition and accordingly, it is dismissed.

Sd/-
